evidence_class: mocked: an in-process caller, a SQLite catalog file and a local content addressed object folder stand in for the session service, the central database and the archive bucket; no HTTP server, Pod or worker runs
interfaces: hooks.memory.catalog adds session_record, session_source and archive_manifest tables keyed by access domain, session uid, source generation and byte offset; they are additive and the SV2-SES-04 tables are unchanged

Catalog.register(SessionSource) records a session at state retained and revision 1 with its provider and retention, and each source generation with its origin; a repeat is idempotent and a changed provider, retention or origin raises Conflict and changes nothing

Catalog.set_state(domain, session_uid, state, revision) is compare and set on revision: it accepts retained, restricted or deleted, advances the revision by one and returns it; a stale revision or unknown session raises Conflict and changes nothing

Catalog.archive(ArchiveEntry) records an immutable object digest for a byte range of a registered generation once; the same entry again returns False and a different end or digest at the offset raises Conflict

hooks.memory.archive.ObjectStore stores objects under their sha256 digest with fsync of the file and its folder and an atomic rename; get verifies the digest and raises EvidenceIntegrityError when the object is missing or altered

hooks.memory.archive.evidence(catalog, store, grant, domain, session_uid) returns complete evidence for a retained session the grant covers: every catalog event, quarantine row and verified archive object of every generation; any missing, altered or wrongly sized object raises EvidenceIntegrityError and increments archive_integrity_failures_total for the domain, and nothing else changes

hooks.memory.archive.source_range(catalog, store, grant, reference) returns the exact archived bytes of a byte range under the same grant and state checks; a range not covered by archived objects raises EvidenceIntegrityError and is counted

hooks.memory.archive.preview(found, limit) returns at most limit characters of text, always labelled complete false with the omitted character count and the session reference; the default limit is the legacy 4000 character preview cap

supported_versions.storage: SQLite catalog with WAL journal and synchronous FULL; local folder object store

states.observed: Cases A, B and C each ran twice from independent temporary folders with identical records.
states.accepted: A session is accepted when register returns its record; an archive entry when archive returns True or False for the same entry.
states.committed: Events are committed by the SV2-SES-04 ingest transaction; sessions, sources, manifest entries and state changes each commit in their own catalog transaction before the call returns.
states.externally_verified: None: no central database, object bucket or deployed service was read or written.

metrics.archive_integrity_failures_total: durable per access domain in ingest_counter, incremented once per refused evidence or range read

rollback_rehearsal.action: Consumers switch back to the earlier catalog event reads; the three new tables and the object folder stay in place and nothing is deleted.
rollback_rehearsal.authoritative_objects: The archived objects and the session_record, session_source, archive_manifest and session_event rows; previews are derived and are never stored.
rollback_rehearsal.proof: Case C closes and reopens the catalog file, reads every exact source range again and replays the whole capture with no duplicate event or manifest row.

remaining_limitations: The object store is a local folder; a bucket backed store with the same put and get contract is not part of this package.
No HTTP route serves evidence or source ranges yet; callers use the module functions in process.
Evidence completeness checks every archived object but does not prove that the manifest covers every event byte range; source_range refuses an uncovered range.
Redis is not touched by this package; it remains coordination and cache only.
compatibility: Explicitly local compatibility path: ingest, its event identity and quarantine rules and the SV2-SES-04 tables are unchanged; the new tables are additive.
authority: Corpus and projects come from the caller's Grant; a session is readable only when its domain is the grant's corpus and every event's project is in the grant or unattributed, and only while its state is retained.
